name: NSN (Never Say Never)
verdict: Barcelona sports and entertainment company co-founded by Andrés Iniesta, one of its main shareholders, and led by founder-president Joel Borràs; Stoneweg became a shareholder in 2025. Nothing found.
note: Title sponsor of the team it co-owns. Rating note: its known shareholders are Andrés Iniesta and Stoneweg (stake not disclosed), which SWI Capital Holding controls (Max-Hervé George, 95.242% of the votes); no state or state fund is sourced in the chain.
